name: Musculocutaneous Neuropathy
definition: Injury or entrapment of the musculocutaneous nerve causing weakness of elbow flexion/supination and sensory symptoms over the lateral forearm.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics localize lesion; ultrasound/MRI is used when structural compression is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent objective motor deficit may require nerve specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Injury or entrapment of the musculocutaneous nerve causing weakness of elbow flexion/supination and sensory symptoms over the lateral forearm.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
